title: शादी एक दिन की, रिश्ता रोज़ का
description: इस हफ़्ते से शादियों का सीज़न शुरू हो रहा है। लाखों रुपये एक शाम पर खर्च हो जाते हैं, पर असली शादी तो उसके बाद की सुबह से शुरू होती है। शादी एक दिन की होती है, रिश्ता रोज़ निभाना पड़ता है। इसे उस इंसान को भेजो, जिसके साथ तुम्हें रोज़ निभाना है।

scenes.narration: इस हफ़्ते से शादियों का सीज़न शुरू हो रहा है।
scenes.image_prompt: A narrow Indian town lane at golden dusk lined with small wedding shops: a stall piled with orange marigold garlands, a tailor's doorway with red and gold lehengas hanging on hooks, a sweet shop with steel trays of orange jalebi, and strings of yellow fairy lights stretching overhead. A middle-aged father in a grey half-sleeve shirt and thin-rimmed glasses walks through the lane holding a stack of shiny red wedding invitation cards against his chest, smiling with hopeful eyes. A festive anticipating mood, square composition with the father centered in the lane. Emotional painterly storybook illustration, gouache and watercolor blend with soft digital brushwork, cinematic warm lighting, expressive human faces, rich textured Indian everyday-life detail, no text, logos or watermarks.

scenes.narration: कोई हॉल देख रहा है, कोई लहंगा, कोई मेन्यू।
scenes.image_prompt: Inside a huge empty wedding banquet hall with crystal chandeliers, white-clothed round tables and a flower-decorated stage, a family stands in the middle making plans: a mother in a green silk saree pointing toward the stage, a young Indian woman of about 25 with a long black braid holding a heavy red-and-gold lehenga against her body, and her father in a grey half-sleeve shirt and thin-rimmed glasses reading a long menu card with a worried frown. A busy excited-but-anxious mood, warm golden light from the chandeliers, square composition with the three of them centered. Emotional painterly storybook illustration, gouache and watercolor blend with soft digital brushwork, cinematic warm lighting, expressive human faces, rich textured Indian everyday-life detail, no text, logos or watermarks.

scenes.image_prompt: A close view of the weathered hands of an older man wearing a thin steel wristwatch, handing a thick bundle of crumpled rupee notes tied with a rubber band across a wooden counter to a decorator in a bright orange kurta, an open ledger and a blue pen lying on the counter. Behind them are boxes of glittering chandeliers, rolls of red carpet and heaps of colorful flower garlands.
